verdict.rationale: Daily is a real-time video and voice infrastructure platform, so in-product AI insights (for example, call analytics suggestions) are a fair question to ask. The evidence shows only Deepgram-powered transcription and Pipecat, a framework for building your own AI agents. Transcription is an adjacent feature and Pipecat is a developer building block, so neither counts as AI-generated insights or suggestions delivered inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
